---
title: RL with slime
---

## Overview

The slime integration uses SearchAgent as the custom rollout and reward layer while
slime manages SGLang rollout workers, Megatron training workers, Ray placement, weight
synchronization, and checkpoints. Both synchronous and fully asynchronous GRPO paths
are available.

## Prerequisites

Install and validate [slime](https://github.com/THUDM/slime) from its official
instructions, including its SGLang, Megatron, router, and Ray dependencies. Install
SearchAgent into that environment. Do not add the full slime stack to a lightweight
SearchAgent inference environment.

Before launch, verify that the cluster can access the model, dataset, SearchAgent
config, search services, embedding services, and shared output paths.

## Configure the agent rollout

`src/searchagent/config/training/train_slime.yaml` defines the agent used inside each
rollout. The launcher reads it from `SEARCHAGENT_AGENT_CONFIG` by default.

The integration provides these main hooks:

| Hook | Path |
| --- | --- |
| Agent rollout | `searchagent.training.slime.rollout.generate_searchagent` |
| Reward model | `searchagent.training.slime.rollout.custom_rm` |
| Fully async rollout | `searchagent.training.slime.fully_async.generate_rollout_fully_async` |
| Rollout metrics | `searchagent.training.slime.rollout.searchagent_rollout_log` |

`SlimeSGLangClient` connects the SearchAgent loop to slime's generation service while
preserving turn boundaries and token metadata needed for training.

## Run training

Run the GRPO template:

```bash
SEARCHAGENT_AGENT_CONFIG=src/searchagent/config/training/train_slime.yaml \
HF_CHECKPOINT=/models/Qwen3-8B \
PROMPT_DATA=/data/train.jsonl \
bash scripts/slime/train_grpo.sh
```

Use `SLIME_ASYNC_MODE=0` for a synchronous sanity run. The scripts expose further
cluster-specific settings as environment variables; review their defaults before a
production run.

## Errors and rewards

The same principles as [RL with AReaL](01-rl-areal.qmd) apply: retry only explicit
recoverable failures, keep the final-answer pattern aligned with the prompt, and record
failure categories separately from task correctness.

The slime rollout metadata includes answer quality, format errors, search behavior,
truncation, context length, and composite reward.
